case_name: A 60-second single take that the free plan has to make in two generations: does the second continue the first?
title: Night ride, a 60 s single take
tests: Tests continuity across a length the free plan cannot make in one generation on every model: whether the second clip continues the first without a visible seam (the same rider, jacket, bike, weather and light), and whether the piece reads as one take.

faults.what: The audio transcript contains spoken German: "Die Wellen plätschern sanft an den Strand." This directly violates the ambient-only, no-speech requirement.
The bridge and approach scenes have a visibly bright gray-blue sky and substantial ambient daylight, reading as dusk rather than the requested night.

judge.summary: The clip depicts the requested rainy bicycle journey and café arrival, but prohibited speech and dusk-like lighting prevent it from meeting the brief.

must_haves.item: One continuous take: no visible cut, jump or change of scene anywhere, including at the midpoint.
must_haves.why: The four frames show a plausible progression toward the same café, but widely spaced stills cannot establish uninterrupted camera movement or exclude a midpoint cut.

must_haves.item: The same rider in the same yellow rain jacket on the same bike from the first second to the last.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames consistently show an apparently matching hooded rider, yellow jacket and dark city bicycle; no clear identity or equipment substitution is visible.

must_haves.item: It starts with her crossing a bridge and ends with her stopping at the lit door of a small café and stepping off the bike.
must_haves.why: The early frame shows the rider crossing a railed bridge, and the late frame shows her stopped at an illuminated café entrance with a leg raised in a dismounting pose.

must_haves.item: Rain and night throughout, with consistent light.
must_haves.why: Wet streets and rainy conditions are consistent, but the visible sky and ambient illumination in the earlier frames read as dusk rather than night.
The supplied duration is 60 seconds, and the frames are 16:9 with a photorealistic live-action appearance.

must_haves.item: Ambient sound only: no music, no speech, no text on screen.
must_haves.why: Speech is explicitly reported in the supplied audio transcription. No added text overlay is apparent, but the speech alone violates this requirement.
